description.value: Sternwheeler Craft Distillery is an award-winning small-batch operation in downtown Creston producing spirits exclusively from locally grown fruit — saskatoons, apples, and other Creston Valley produce — with no grains, nuts, or artificial additives. Founded in 2017 as Wynndel Craft Distilleries, it relocated to a converted heritage building on Canyon Street in 2024 and opened a Lounge Bar in early 2025 stocked entirely with local beers, wines, ciders, and its own spirits. The distillery has accumulated multiple Canadian Artisan Spirit Competition honours including several Best in Class and Gold medals, making it a notable destination in the Kootenays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active craft distillery and lounge bar at 1628 Canyon Street, Creston, with a Taste Room, on-site store, and Lounge Bar opened February 2025. OSM phone (250-428-1764) and address match the website exactly. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website text, so those fields are null; the on-site shop selling bottled spirits to go supports a true value for Takeout.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, award-winning craft distillery with Taste Room, Lounge Bar, and on-site shop in downtown Creston — a worthwhile and distinctive stop for touring cyclists exploring the Kootenays.
